verdict.rationale: Connecting cloud drive, email and calendar is a fair question for an AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manual file upload with Q&A, a generic plugins/skills section, and Kimi Claw's Feishu integration ("接入飞书"), which is not documented as giving the assistant searchable access to drive, mail or calendar data. None of these are documented connectors for this story.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers
